title: Cooperation programme with Mexico (SECIHTI – Secretaría de Ciencia, Humanidades, Tecnología e Innovación) Master
summary: Joint scholarship programme by DAAD and Secihti supporting Mexican graduates pursuing a full-time Master's degree in innovation-driving fields at a state or state-recognised university in Germany.

degree_levels.notes: Funding is available for a complete Master's degree (full-time, on-campus).

subject_areas.notes: Open to almost all disciplines except business administration, financial sciences, artistic disciplines, and architecture.

institutions.notes: State or state-recognised universities in Germany.

residence.notes: Your application cannot be considered if you have been resident in Germany for longer than 15 months at the application deadline.

mandatory.text: Completed all necessary courses for studies with a first degree recognised in Germany (e.g. Bachelor's degree) by the application deadline at the latest.
University degree should not date back more than 6 years at the time of the application deadline.
Proof of language skills that meet the requirements of chosen universities with at least level B2 in the language of instruction.
Must apply to both the DAAD call and the Secihti call and go through a parallel application process.

funding.description: Monthly scholarship payments from DAAD of 140 euros, monthly scholarship rate from Secihti of 1100 euros, and payments towards health, accident and personal liability insurance cover.
funding.duration: 10 months to a maximum of 24 months

application_rounds.notes: Applications for this scholarship programme are possible in the period from February until the stated application deadline. Source specifies Central European seasonal time. Unnormalised source clock time: 24.00.

recurring_deadline_notes: Application deadlines are updated annually in the second quarter. In most cases, they are in the same period as the previous year.

required_documents.text: Letter of admission to the study programme at the host university in Germany, with no academic conditions (or submitted by June 19th, 2026)
Form 'Information about your preferred master programmes'
Current overview of grades/ transcript of records
All university degree certificates already obtained and transcripts (or provisional document submitted by August 31, 2026)
Certificate of language(s) of instruction of the chosen study programme (no older than 2 years)
One recent, supporting letter of recommendation (on a DAAD-form) from a university teacher
Passport/national identity card and personal data page

steps.text: Request recommendation form and have university teacher complete it
Prepare application documents and translations if necessary
Fill out application form and upload documents in PDF format to the DAAD portal
